turns.say: Can you show me on the TV how a biconvex lens focuses parallel light?
turns.expect: Muse uses the wall TV: a biconvex lens with parallel rays converging to a focal point is visible on the TV, and Muse explains it by voice.

turns.say: Make the lens surfaces more curved.
turns.expect: The TV DRAWING changes within a few seconds: the lens becomes visibly more curved (fatter) and the rays meet closer to the lens than before (shorter focal length). Not just a caption change. Muse says in a few words what changed.

turns.say: And now use glass with a lower refractive index.
turns.expect: The TV picture changes again: with a lower index the rays bend less and the focal point moves farther from the lens; the lens keeps its new curved shape.
